copyonwritearraylist-concept.title: CopyOnWriteArrayList
copyonwritearraylist-concept.short: Use a concurrent list for read-heavy workloads
copyonwritearraylist-concept.summary: CopyOnWriteArrayList copies its backing array on updates so readers can iterate over stable snapshots.
copyonwritearraylist-concept.why: It can reduce explicit locking for shared lists that are read often and changed rarely.
copyonwritearraylist-concept.tips: Each mutation copies the array, so avoid it for write-heavy workloads.
